briefdescription.para: Prepare the runtime core list and find an existing core entry.

parameterdescription.para: Core whose runtime entry is requested
Pointer to receive the matching entry, or NULL on a miss

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the list is available, or XST_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL when the list cannot be allocated

briefdescription.para: Store idle-notification support in a runtime core entry.

parameterdescription.para: Core whose runtime entry is updated.
Idle-support value whose low 8 bits are stored.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, or XST_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL on allocation failure.

briefdescription.para: Store whether the given core supports idle notifications.

detaileddescription.para: A runtime entry is allocated and added when the core has not been seen before; otherwise the existing entry is updated.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the core whose idle support is updated
Idle-support value whose low 8 bits are stored

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_INVALID_PARAM for a NULL core, or XST_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL if runtime storage cannot be allocated

briefdescription.para: Retrieve the stored idle-notification support for a core.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the core to look up
Pointer to receive the stored support value

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_INVALID_PARAM for a NULL argument, or XST_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND when no runtime entry exists for the core

briefdescription.para: Retrieves the stored forced power down request for the given core.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the core to look up
Pointer that is updated with the forced power down request

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: Store a forced power-down request in a runtime core entry.

parameterdescription.para: Core whose runtime entry is updated.
Forced power-down request to store.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, or XST_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL on allocation failure.

briefdescription.para: Stores the forced power down request for the given core, allocating a runtime core entry if one does not already exist.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the core to update
Forced power down request to store

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: Calculate the wake-up latency for a core device.

detaileddescription.para: A running core has zero latency. For a non-running core, the function adds the wake-up latency of its power node when one is present.

parameterdescription.para: Core device node ID
Non-NULL pointer to receive the latency; initialized to zero

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the latency is available, XST_INVALID_PARAM when no device exists for DeviceId, or an error from the power node latency query

briefdescription.para: Processes a pending forced power down for the subsystem, and triggers a subsystem power off or restart once all of its cores are off.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the subsystem being processed
Pointer to the core that triggered the processing

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: Release a core and process its subsystem's pending transition.

parameterdescription.para: Core being released.
Pointer to receive the owning subsystem identifier.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, or the first operation error encountered.

briefdescription.para: Releases the given core from its subsystem and processes any pending forced power down for that subsystem.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the core to release

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: Pulse the APU GIC reset if every APU core is off.

detaileddescription.para: Pulses the APU GIC reset when all APU cores are powered off and the FPD power domain is on.
The APU GIC is shared by all APU clusters, so it is only reset while FPD is on and no APU core device is up.

parameterdescription.para: Any APU core device ID; only its type is checked, any other type leaves the GIC untouched

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if the GIC was reset or did not need a reset, or the error of the reset otherwise

briefdescription.para: Enable or disable the clock for the given core.

detaileddescription.para:
CoreId :
Node ID of the core
Enable :
Non-zero to enable the clock, zero to disable it
XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise Enable or disable the clock for the given core.
